# James Baker

James Baker is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2011.

James Baker has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/james-baker#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 with 42% of the ballot.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111017042554/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-helier-district-1/james-baker/)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928162425/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=25)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto 2](https://web.archive.org/web/20120121024207/http://www.jamesbaker.co.je:80/2011/09/headline)

## Election History

### 2011 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Helier No 1](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier-no-1) (3 seats), 7th September 2011.

**James Baker was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 in 2011**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **James Baker** |  | 767 | 42% |
| 2 | **[Trevor Pitman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/trevor-pitman)** |  | 763 | 41.7% |
| 3 | **[Judy Martin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/judy-martin)** |  | 717 | 39.2% |
| 4 | [Paul Le Claire](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/paul-le-claire) |  | 700 | 38.3% |
| 5 | [Nick Le Cornu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nick-le-cornu) |  | 571 | 31.2% |
| 6 | [Keith Shaw](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/keith-shaw) |  | 482 | 26.4% |
| 7 | [Mary O’Keeffe](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mary-okeeffe) |  | 331 | 18.1% |
| 8 | [Gino Risoli](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gino-risoli) |  | 178 | 9.7% |

1,828 ballots (inc. 18 spoilt papers)

5,059 registered voters

= 36.1% turnout
